about: Viewer personas for scripts/bench/taste_bench.py. Chosen from general knowledge of real fan overlap, never from this engine's output. Ratings: loves 1, likes 0.7, dislikes -1.

personas.label: Prestige crime drama
personas.notes: Cable and streaming crime sagas with long character arcs. Dislikes are network case-of-the-week procedurals: the same crime genre tags, a very different taste.

personas.label: British panel comedy
personas.notes: UK comedy panel and quiz shows built on comedians riffing. Deliberately niche: The Big Fat Quiz sits just under the default popularity floor.

likes.name: Have I Got News for You

personas.label: Cozy mysteries
personas.notes: Village and period whodunits with little on-screen gore. Dislikes are graphic horror, which shares the murder vocabulary but not the tone. Deliberately niche: Murder, She Wrote and Agatha Christie Poirot premiered before 1990; Rosemary & Thyme is below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Shonen anime
personas.notes: Long-running battle and adventure anime. Dislikes are celebrity and party reality TV. Deliberately niche: Dragon Ball Z premiered in 1989.

dislikes.name: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills

personas.label: Adult animation
personas.notes: Satirical and absurdist animated comedy for grown-ups. Dislikes are preschool cartoons: the same Animation format, the opposite audience. Deliberately niche: The Simpsons premiered in 1989.

personas.label: Workplace comedy and mockumentary
personas.notes: Single-camera ensemble comedies, many shot as mockumentaries. All loves and likes, no dislikes. Holds both versions of The Office (US 2005 and UK 2001).

likes.name: What We Do in the Shadows

personas.label: Scandinavian noir
personas.notes: Bleak Nordic police and conspiracy dramas, mostly in Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Icelandic and Finnish, plus the US remake of The Killing. Deliberately niche: Modus and Jordskott sit below the default popularity floor.

personas.label: K-drama romance
personas.notes: Korean romantic comedies and melodramas. Dislikes are Korean zombie and creature horror, which share the language and channel but not the mood. Deliberately niche: Crash Landing on You, Descendants of the Sun and the disliked Kingdom sit below the default popularity floor.

loves.name: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God

likes.name: It's Okay to Not Be Okay

personas.label: Korean thrillers
personas.notes: Korean survival, revenge, crime and creature thrillers. Deliberately niche: Kingdom, Vincenzo and Stranger sit below the default popularity floor.

personas.label: Mind-bending sci-fi
personas.notes: Puzzle-box and reality-bending science fiction. No dislikes.

personas.label: Epic fantasy
personas.notes: Big-budget sword-and-sorcery sagas and their predecessors. No dislikes.

likes.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power

personas.label: Teen drama
personas.notes: High-school and twenty-something soaps from the WB and CW era to Netflix and HBO.

personas.label: Reality competition
personas.notes: Elimination game shows and competitive reality. Dislikes are dense serialized sci-fi and anime that everyone recommended. Deliberately niche: America's Next Top Model sits below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Cooking competition
personas.notes: Kitchen contests and chef reality. Dislikes are serial-killer dramas; Hannibal in particular talks about cooking constantly, which makes it a good trap for plot-text similarity. Deliberately niche: Nailed It! sits well below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Nature documentaries
personas.notes: Landmark wildlife series. Dislikes are sensational reality that happens to involve animals or glamour. Deliberately niche: TVmaze rates Planet Earth II, Blue Planet II, Our Planet and Frozen Planet below the default popularity floor.

dislikes.name: Tiger King: Murder, Mayhem and Madness

personas.label: True crime docuseries
personas.notes: Investigative docuseries plus a couple of cable true-crime staples. Soupçons is the French production known in English as The Staircase. Deliberately niche: Don't F**k with Cats and the Ted Bundy Tapes sit below the popularity floor.

loves.name: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst

likes.name: I'll Be Gone in the Dark
Night Stalker: The Hunt for a Serial Killer
Tiger King: Murder, Mayhem and Madness
Don't F**k with Cats: Hunting an Internet Killer
Conversations with a Killer: The Ted Bundy Tapes

personas.label: Medical drama
personas.notes: Hospital ensembles from ER to The Pitt. Deliberately niche: St. Elsewhere premiered in 1982 and Private Practice sits below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Police procedural
personas.notes: Network case-of-the-week crime. The mirror of prestige_crime: dislikes are slow-burn and surreal prestige crime that shares the genre tags.

personas.label: Superhero
personas.notes: Marvel, DC and creator-owned superhero series, live action and animated. No dislikes.

personas.label: British period drama
personas.notes: Costume drama and literary adaptations. Dislikes are crude comedy, party reality and gory horror. Deliberately niche: Cranford sits just under the popularity floor.

personas.label: Classic multi-camera sitcoms
personas.notes: Studio-audience network sitcoms. Deliberately niche by era: Seinfeld, Cheers, The Golden Girls and Married... with Children premiered before 1990, so the default year floor removes them.

personas.label: Cringe comedy
personas.notes: Awkward, uncomfortable single-camera comedy. Dislikes are laugh-track CBS sitcoms: same genre, opposite sensibility. Deliberately niche: Nathan for You, Extras and Summer Heights High sit below the popularity floor.

likes.name: I Think You Should Leave with Tim Robinson

personas.label: Horror
personas.notes: Supernatural, gothic and survival horror series. No dislikes.

likes.name: The Fall of the House of Usher

personas.label: Spy thrillers
personas.notes: Espionage from le Carre to Jack Bauer, including the French Le Bureau des Legendes and the Israeli Fauda. Deliberately niche: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy premiered in 1979.

personas.label: Space opera
personas.notes: Starships, empires and frontier crews. No dislikes.

personas.label: Star Trek
personas.notes: One franchise across sixty years plus The Orville; the easiest persona for plot text, so a sanity check. Deliberately niche by era: the original series, The Next Generation and The Animated Series premiered before 1990.

personas.label: Family drama
personas.notes: Warm ensemble family and small-town drama. No dislikes.

personas.label: Westerns
personas.notes: Frontier and modern Westerns. Dislikes are glossy teen soaps. Deliberately niche: Lonesome Dove (1989) and Gunsmoke (1955) predate the year floor.

personas.label: Indian web series
personas.notes: Hindi-language streaming originals. Niche-heavy on purpose: TVmaze popularity is low for most Indian shows, so only The Family Man, Asur, Special OPS and Breathe clear the default floor.

personas.label: Spanish-language drama
personas.notes: Spanish and Mexican streaming and network drama. Deliberately niche: Who Killed Sara? and Sky Rojo sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Latin telenovela
personas.notes: Classic Mexican, Colombian and Telemundo telenovelas plus Jane the Virgin, the English-language homage. Niche-heavy on purpose: Pasion de Gavilanes, La Usurpadora, Rubi, La fea mas bella, Teresa and Maria la del Barrio sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Turkish drama
personas.notes: Turkish dizi: Ottoman epics, romances and family crime. Deliberately niche: Ask-i Memnu and Kurulus: Osman sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Kids animation
personas.notes: Preschool and all-ages cartoons watched by a family with young children. Dislikes are adult animation, the mirror of adult_animation. Deliberately niche: Octonauts sits below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Legal drama
personas.notes: Courtroom and law-firm drama, including the Korean Extraordinary Attorney Woo. Deliberately niche: L.A. Law premiered in 1986.

likes.name: How to Get Away with Murder

personas.label: Political drama
personas.notes: Government and campaign drama from the US, UK, Denmark and France. No dislikes.

personas.label: Slice-of-life anime
personas.notes: Gentle iyashikei and everyday-life anime. Dislikes are gore anime: the same Japanese Animation format, the opposite mood. Niche-heavy on purpose: most loved titles sit below the popularity floor while every dislike clears it.

likes.name: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

personas.label: Prestige limited series
personas.notes: Acclaimed miniseries and short-run dramas. Deliberately niche: When They See Us sits below the popularity floor.

personas.label: 1990s nostalgia
personas.notes: What a kid of the nineties watched: TGIF sitcoms, teen shows and syndicated action. Deliberately niche: Saved by the Bell and Family Matters premiered in 1989; Clarissa sits below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Japanese live action
personas.notes: Japanese TV dramas and Netflix originals. Niche-heavy on purpose: only Alice in Borderland and Sanctuary clear the default popularity floor.

personas.label: Stand-up and sketch
personas.notes: Sketch shows and stand-up showcases. Deliberately niche by era: Saturday Night Live, Monty Python and The Kids in the Hall premiered before 1990; Chappelle's Show sits below the popularity floor.

likes.name: Tim and Eric Awesome Show, Great Job!

personas.label: Feel-good comedy
personas.notes: Kind-hearted ensemble comedy. Dislikes are grim, violent hits the viewer bailed on.

personas.label: Historical epics
personas.notes: Swords, sails and dynasties from Rome to the Vikings to feudal Japan. Deliberately niche: Barbaren sits just under the popularity floor.

personas.label: Psychological and sci-fi anime
personas.notes: Cerebral, dark and cyberpunk anime. Deliberately niche: Monster, Paranoia Agent, Psycho-Pass and Code Geass sit below the popularity floor.

likes.name: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

personas.label: Home renovation and lifestyle
personas.notes: HGTV renovation, makeover and real-estate reality. Dislikes are horror hits. Deliberately niche: Fixer Upper, Selling Sunset and Tidying Up sit below the popularity floor and This Old House premiered in 1979.

personas.label: German-language drama
personas.notes: German streaming and public-broadcaster drama. Deutschland is the 2015 series known as Deutschland 83. Deliberately niche: Unorthodox and Der Tatortreiniger sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: French-language drama
personas.notes: French streaming and Canal+ drama and comedy. Deliberately niche: Marianne, Braquo, Au service de la France, Hippocrate, Kaamelott and Plan Coeur sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Sports docuseries
personas.notes: Behind-the-scenes sports documentaries. Dislikes are dating reality. Deliberately niche: Last Chance U, Sunderland 'Til I Die, All or Nothing, Cheer, Break Point and Full Swing sit below the popularity floor.

personas.label: Late-night talk and news satire
personas.notes: US late-night and topical comedy plus Graham Norton. Deliberately niche: The Colbert Report, Full Frontal and Patriot Act sit below the popularity floor.

loves.name: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
The Daily Show with Jon Stewart
The Late Show with Stephen Colbert

likes.name: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon

personas.label: Women-led dramedy
personas.notes: Half-hour comedies and dramedies centred on women's lives. No dislikes.

personas.label: Soap operas
personas.notes: British, Australian and American daily soaps. Niche by era on purpose: most long-running soaps premiered before 1990, so the default year floor removes them.

personas.label: British crime drama
personas.notes: Modern and classic UK detective drama, darker than the cozy set. Deliberately niche: Inspector Morse premiered in 1987.
